summary: Iter18 tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing — roof_facade calculator (list + compute + math checks pitch 30/35/45/0 + warnings pitch>60 & no rampant + material qty formulas), plan compare (happy path with 3 added/removed/modified pattern, 400 on same plan_id, 404 on unknown, empty plans, tolerance boundary 5%/1%), non-regression (estimation/compute, prices/optimize existence, admin/revenue/kpis, share/sms/config, push/public-key). Frontend UI: /plan/compare loads correctly with H1 'Comparez le plan existant et le projet', both data-testid compare-before-select / compare-after-select / compare-run-btn / compare-back present and functional; back button navigates to /plan; plan-compare-link visible on /plan page.

minor.issue: Warning 'Rampant non fourni' is emitted even when pitch_deg is provided and valid — could be misleading; probably intended only when neither pitch nor rampant present.
Frontend does not forward surface_tolerance_pct (always uses backend default of 5) — no UI control to change tolerance.

action_items: (Optional) Add a tolerance slider/input in PlanCompare.jsx to expose surface_tolerance_pct.
(Optional) Refine the 'Rampant non fourni' warning to only appear when no useful geometry is provided.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/plans.py compare_plans: name matching is O(n) with dict-of-list — correct; first-match-wins is documented. Consider stable sort by surface for deterministic pairing when duplicates exist.

engines/calculators.py roof_facade: rampant branch uses length_estim = projected/(2*rampant) which yields real_area = 2*rampant*(projected/(2*rampant)) = projected — the override effectively cancels itself; formula should be revisited to actually leverage the rampant value.
seed_data_creation: Test plans created via /api/takeoffs/upload with 1x1 PNG then calibrated ppm=100 and rooms added (Salon/Cuisine/SDB before; Salon/Chambre/Cellier after; and tolerance-boundary pair 30 vs 30.5 m²).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter18 is green. Login token key is 'token' (not 'access_token'). Calculators endpoint is /api/calculators (not /api/tools/...). PlanCompare page is functional with data-testids compare-before-select / compare-after-select / compare-run-btn / compare-back and plan-compare-link on /plan.
